description: TfL publishes yellow-box junction polygons extracted from its Metros traffic-order system. Attributes include enforcement-zone identifier, street location, area, boundary length and update date. Coverage includes permanent and selected long-term temporary orders on red routes and excludes most borough-road and clearway locations. The layer represents mapped traffic controls, not observed compliance or capacity. It can delineate junction controls when combined with a separately validated traffic network. Coverage is Greater London. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The item states TfL as-is terms without identifying a standard reuse licence. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides planning or policy-area inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing TfL 2023 PTAL grid.
